retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>：童年孙儿，Male child around seven, thin and small with a large child's head ratio, narrow shoulders and a quick light-footed stance; tanned skin, short cropped black hair with a sweaty fringe; faded sleeveless cotton vest, dark knee-length shorts, cheap plastic sandals.
<Picture 2>：堂屋，The main room of an old village house. A slanted bar of afternoon sunlight pushes through a wooden lattice door across the packed earthen floor, catching drifting motes. The dominant form is a large brick stove counter along one wall, its black iron pot still breathing a thin thread of steam; beside it a dark square wooden table is set with two pairs of bamboo chopsticks on worn bowls. Whitewashed brick walls, a low door lintel, a clay water vat in the corner; through the doorway the tiled roofs and treetops of ordinary village houses mark the scale.

detailed_description:
Live-action cinematic realism shot as a 1990s memory on the North China plain, 35mm film texture with restrained camera movement; coarse sun-bleached cotton, straw weave, weathered wood, chipped enamel and dirt-ground skin rendered in tactile close detail; two strict timeline grades — remembered scenes in warm honey-gold amber light, present scenes in cold desaturated gray-ochre under a harsh white sun, interiors near a four-to-one chiaroscuro; classical layered composition of foreground occlusion (doorframes, wall corners, grass blades), mid-ground figures and deep empty negative space, with long shadows carrying the emotion; in the present timeline the camera keeps seeing the protagonist as the same small boy until the reveal shot, where he resolves at last into his true adult self.

[Shot 1] A static wide shot frames the dim main room of <Picture 2>, dust motes drifting through a slanted bar of afternoon light from the wooden lattice door; a small boy in a faded sleeveless vest stands alone on the packed earthen floor facing the inner doorway. He cups both hands to his mouth and calls out: <d>[Chinese]奶奶——</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000 a medium shot holds on <Picture 1>, his head tilted toward the doorway as he waits; only silence comes back. He shifts his weight from one sandal to the other and calls again: <d>[Chinese]爷爷——</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000 a medium close shot catches him calling a third time, louder: <d>[Chinese]奶奶！</d> Still nobody answers. He turns to the brick stove, rises onto his tiptoes and peers into the faintly warm iron pot without lifting its lid, then spins around and runs for the door, his sandals slapping the floor.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet room tone inside <Picture 2>, with a distant rooster crow and faint village birds; the boy's three calls echo softly off whitewashed brick, and a faint breath of steam hisses off the warm pot. All detail sounds stay below his voice.
